description: Concrete binding-vow effects: an effect-type discriminator, type-dependent numeric parameters, and the battle-text ID used to describe the effect in UI.

Id.technical: FName row key in BindingVowsEffectDataTable; export label ID. Resolved from BindingVowsDataTable.Id_BindingVowsEffect by GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows (first matching table wins, None skipped) and by DTM_FindBindingVowsEffectRow in the VsEnemy selection UI. The row pointer is stored in FGameCharacterBindingVowsEffectState::Effect for subsequent type/value queries.

EffectType.simple: Which gameplay/stat effect this row applies.
EffectType.technical: EGameBindingVowsEffectType (uint8; None default, Invalid=255; ~80 named cases such as ForceGaugeMax, HitPointMax, CursedEnergyRecover, MoveSpeed, DashGaugeMax, SendAttackDamage, ReceiveDamage, DeadPenalty and mission rewards). It is filtered by GameBindingVows_GetEffectRowsOfType and switched on by status/UI consumers; it also drives the widget category grouping (hit point / movement / attack / cursed energy / other) and MissionOrder/MissionTask effect-type exclusions during PvE vow selection. Several accesses of array values are valid only for particular effect types.

EffectValue.simple: Type-dependent numeric parameters; usually a chance/threshold followed by a magnitude.
EffectValue.technical: TArray<float> (all exported rows have two entries, but consumers select indices per EffectType). [0] is variously an additive modifier (ForceGaugeMax summed and clamped to at least 1), a battle-log threshold/required count (JumpCount, GuardCount, SpecialTagComboCount, DeadKillWithTime, DeadPenalty, DeadSendGuard, HitPointOnce), or a 0..1 chance multiplied by 100 for RollChance kind 2 (HitPointWhenJustGuard and other probability effects). [1] is typically the applied magnitude, e.g. HitPointWhenJustGuard adds HitPointMax * [1], while HitPointOnce adds int32([1] * HitPointMax). Some queries use only [0] via Sum/Max. Index 1 is read unguarded by consumers when the type expects it; do not treat the array as a generic scalar list.

Id_BattleText.simple: Battle-text row ID used to render the vow effect description.
Id_BattleText.technical: FName key resolved through the BattleText system by SetTextIdWithParameters. UGameVsEnemyBindingVowsSelectWidget::OnVowFocused requires the effect's EffectValue.Num() >= 2, supplies VALUE = EffectValue[0] and VALUE2 = EffectValue[1] as text parameters, then shows either the debuff ([0] of the vow) or buff ([1]) text. No other direct reader of this BindingVowsEffect property was identified in the reconstructed source.

notes: AGameDataTableManager::Tick resolves only BindingVowsEffectDataTable into BindingVowsEffectDataTables (Source/Abrams/Private/GameDataTableManager.cpp:291, Source/Abrams/Public/GameDataTableManager.h:202).

The row is reached almost entirely through BindingVowsDataTable.Id_BindingVowsEffect joins: GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows and GameBindingVows_GetEffectRowsOfType are the central accessors used by status, PvE selection and UI code.

EffectValue's meaning is not uniform. Index roles were read directly from type-specific consumers; do not infer units for all rows from a single exported sample. Chance values are represented as 0..1 fractions before the *100 conversion in RollChance calls.

An unrelated structure, EquipmentItemEffect, has fields with the same names; the GameItemDescriptionTextWidget.cpp hits for EffectValue/Id_BattleText are for that type and are deliberately not used as evidence here.
Reconstructed static C++ only; partial Content means additional Blueprint/uncooked consumers cannot be excluded.

usages.detail: GameBindingVows_GetEffectRows joins vow IDs to these rows, skipping None IDs and taking the first table match.
GameBindingVows_GetEffectRowsOfType filters joined rows by EffectType for status queries and UI records.
GetBindingVowsRecords builds current/required battle-log progress from EffectType and EffectValue[0].
ForceGaugeMax sums EffectValue[0] over active vows and clamps the result.
HitPointWhenJustGuard rolls EffectValue[0]*100 and then adds HitPointMax*EffectValue[1].
Maps EffectType to the vow icon's hit-point/movement/attack/cursed-energy/other category.
Formats the debuff/buff descriptions with Id_BattleText and both EffectValue parameters.
Mission vow selection excludes candidates whose effect types are forbidden by mission orders or tasks.
